source_title: Gao et al. (2007), Molecular phylogeny of the Drosophila obscura species group, with emphasis on the Old World species
source_location: Divergence times in the obscura species group; Figure 4 and accompanying text

Dpse_Dmir.range_kind: estimated ages reported under that dating model

plotting_policy: Use arithmetic midpoints of the stated ranges to define one illustrative ultrametric chronogram; draw the stated ranges separately. Midpoints are display choices, not newly estimated divergence dates. Ranges are not confidence intervals.
uncertainty: Dates depend on the calibration and clock model. Other studies report younger Dpse-Dmir divergences and different melanogaster-obscura divergence dates; this is one explicitly identified published chronology, not a consensus estimate.
